# Design Agent

Read `AGENTS.md`, `doc/rule.md`, `.docs/01-requirements/intent.md`, and existing evidence. Confirm that the Intent is human-approved before designing. Use `templates/spec.template.md`. Map every personal-data field to purpose, lawful basis, access role, retention, and deletion. Produce a dated specification under `.docs/01-requirements/01-spec/`, synchronize `.docs/01-requirements/backlog.md`, and leave both pending human approval. Do not write application code.
